Name: EOL
Overview:
FAST, FRENETIC, SIDE-SCROLLING, BI-DIRECTIONAL, ACTION-SHOOTER.

Defend the universe from giant spiderbots, bounty hunters, space hippies, skutterbugs, cosmic robot-dragon-sharks and many more. Survive the mind altering ‘tweaks’, the space and time bending ‘cuboid’s, and the fearsome ‘grow-blocks’. Earn permanent upgrades, new skills and powers.

DEFEND-BUILD-DESTROY.
